57.30862,-2.86844: St. Mary's Church. The Ancient Parish Church, built in the 13th Century, was extensively altered in the 17th Century with larger windows replacing all but one of the origial lancets. Outstanding features surviving from the mediaeval church are this south door, richly detailed externally, and the sacrament house on the north wall. Designed to hold the consecrated host.
57.44697,-2.78433: In this house George MacDonald was born 10 December 1824
